purpose: Verified source data for Proofline showcase documents; observations are not a benchmark or a speedup comparison.

snapshot.documentationRelation: These measurements describe the tested implementation snapshot; later documentation commits are distinct and are not claimed to have passed the official gate.
snapshot.officialGateStatus: Both official completion passes passed. Pass 2 is recorded in the ignored progress ledger so the final validated tracked head remains unchanged.

ledgerProvenance.note: The append-only tracked ledger ends with official Pass 1. Pass 2 is recorded in progress.md and its retained log.

canonicalCommandDefinitions.definition: 14 registered command definitions; canonical-full selects five execution command keys. The full completion gate also executes governance, builds/audits and direct verification commands.

ownershipBindings.definition: Each manifest binding ties a rule and layer to an exact executable test identity. Several bindings may point to the same test; binding counts are not test counts.

exclusions.reason: No user-visible reference control exists; add a browser workflow when the UI exposes this operation.

goldenWorkflowRows.definition: Six implemented rows include one cross-browser smoke row. One excluded row names two operations without visible reference controls: cancellation and commission payment. Their deterministic service/runtime evidence remains in scope.

canonicalUnitCycle.definition: Totals sum the ten top-level Vitest workspace summaries once per canonical unit invocation. Nested subprocess browser summaries are not added. These totals repeat in canonical-full and direct invocations.

browserScope.optionalSmokeStatus: Firefox and WebKit are registered, but the progress ledger records missing local browser binaries; the official gate logs verify Chromium only.
browserScope.uniqueCountingRule: The separate 24-test scenario run and two 12-test shards repeat tests already included in the 43-test canonical browser suite. Do not sum these counts into a unique-test total. The 43-test suite includes fixture/containment tests and legacy checks, not only visible product workflows.

timingMethodology.classification: Observed reporter durations for two local validation passes; not a controlled performance benchmark.
timingMethodology.fullCompletionGateDurationNote: No complete-chain wall-clock duration is retained in these logs. Do not infer one by summing overlapping or partial reporter timings.
timingMethodology.browserBoundary: Playwright suite duration as printed in its final passed summary. The manifest prerequisite test artifact build is separately reported by Nx and is excluded from this duration.
timingMethodology.unitBoundary: Vitest workspace Duration summaries; no complete canonical-unit command elapsed duration is claimed. Transform/setup/collect/test/environment subtimings may overlap and are not additive wall-clock components.
timingMethodology.coverageBoundary: Nx duration for the eleven instrumented coverage targets. This is coverage collection cost, separate from ordinary test execution timing; coverage percentages measure exercised source, not runtime performance.
timingMethodology.conditions: Fresh generated-state completion runs are documented in progress.md. Nx reports 0 cache hits for the recorded typecheck, build and coverage target runs. Chromium suite and shard runs use five local workers; scenario-contract verification uses two. CI config uses two workers and retries, so these local timings are not CI projections.
excludedClaims: No speedup, time saved, cost saved or comparison with an LLM-based testing baseline is established.
The two passes are observations, not a statistically meaningful timing distribution.
No Firefox/WebKit runtime result is implied by their registration.

coverageMethodology.governanceDefinition: The gate ratchets manifest-selected source files, with explicit resolved exclusions and checked producer provenance. It is narrower than the complete set of coverage reports.
coverageMethodology.aggregateDefinition: For descriptive aggregate percentages, sum covered units and total units over the selected disjoint files, then divide covered by total. Do not average rounded file/workspace percentages. Aggregate figures are descriptive and do not replace the per-file ratchet.
coverageMethodology.exclusionSummary: Explicit exclusions include test sources, barrels/type declarations, noncritical legacy wiring, deterministic test fixtures, and selected real child-process implementations whose V8 coverage is not merged. See each group for exact files and reasons.
limitations: tools/proofline/canonical-runner.mjs is included in governance and currently reports 0/263 covered lines. Real child-process integration tests exercise this runner, while this V8 report records no attributed line coverage; the zero result is retained, not removed.
packages/test-kit has no local test files and its separate full report retains 0/124 covered lines.
Coverage is not proof that every behavior or risk is tested; deterministic behavior evidence and visible workflow evidence serve separate purposes.
